notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Stuffy Doll if it has summoning sickness.
description:
Deal damage to Stuffy Doll, either using its ability or another method.
Stuffy Doll and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Stuffy Doll trigger, dealing damage to the named player.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Stuffy Doll instead due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.
